services.name: Pediatrics
services.summary: Consultations for newborns, infants and children with our Children Specialist.
services.description: The Pediatrics department at Eternal Multi Specialty Hospital, Palakurthy, is led by Dr. M. Naresh (M.B.B.S, DCH, MIAP), a Children Specialist. Parents can bring newborns, infants and children for consultation. The hospital has a newborn care area with radiant warmers. Please call the hospital or book an appointment to confirm the doctor's availability.
services.imageAlt: Newborn care area with radiant warmers at Eternal Multi Specialty Hospital

services.name: General Medicine
services.summary: Consultations for adults with our General Physician (MD General Medicine).
services.description: The General Medicine department at Eternal Multi Specialty Hospital, Palakurthy, is led by Dr. M. Haritha (M.B.B.S, MD General Medicine), who also holds a Fellowship in Echocardiography. Adults can book a consultation with the General Physician. Please call the hospital or book an appointment to confirm the doctor's availability.

facilities.description: A spacious reception desk and waiting hall with seating for patients and families.

facilities.description: Lakshmi Eternal Pharmacy (లక్ష్మీ ఎటర్నల్ ఫార్మసీ) – a well-stocked medicine counter (మందుల షాపు) inside the hospital.

facilities.name: In-house Laboratory

facilities.name: Oxygen Supply
facilities.description: Medical oxygen supply through a cylinder manifold system, available for patients who need it.

facilities.name: Convenient location
facilities.description: Opposite the Bus Stand on Jangaon Road, Palakurthy. Easy to reach by bus.
